What PMEX Does

Built to remove the friction from
every stage of your revenue cycle

Handle every billing task

PMEX's certified billers and coders handle charge entry, claim scrubbing, submission, follow-up, payment posting, and denial appeals. Your team focuses on patients, not paperwork.

Reduce denials before they happen

PMEX specialty billers review every claim against payer-specific rules and documentation requirements before submission, stopping preventable denials at the source with a 99% clean claim rate.

See your revenue clearly via PMEX Portal

The PMEX Portal gives you real-time visibility into collections, denials, A/R aging, and payer performance, updated by your billing team around the clock. No setup. Log in and see everything.

Dedicated account management

Every PMEX client has a dedicated billing specialist and account manager. Issues are surfaced and resolved proactively. You are never waiting for a generic support queue to respond.
